name: Lookahead of 32 states per move, spent by puct
description: During training, before each move the policy may examine up to 32 states, choosing which ones by the 'puct' rule, using the real rules of the game to look ahead and its own value estimates to judge what it finds. It then plays the move the lookahead favours, and is trained to rate that move as the lookahead valued it. Targets are clamped into the range the rewards actually span, which is the fix for the failure recorded in exp-022, where unbounded targets inflated the value scale until the network preferred a good move to a winning one. Evaluation remains a single look with no lookahead.

data_rules.note: tactical shaping is off: a lookahead of this size already sees immediate wins and threats, so the hand-written penalty for missing them is redundant and is one less piece of borrowed knowledge

notes: Rests on a measured result (exp-023): the same network scored 0.116 playing immediately and 0.339 when allowed 400 states of lookahead, so its judgment of positions is better than its instant choice of move. This recipe trains the instant choice toward the considered one.
